name: opencode
description: Installs a pinned opencode CLI and provisions dynamic authentication workflows with a persistent session volume.

version.description: opencode CLI version to install (pinned; avoid floating latest)

onCreateCommand: mkdir -p ${HOME}/.local/share/opencode ${HOME}/.opencode-host-sync && if [ -f ${HOME}/.opencode-host-sync/auth.json ]; then cp ${HOME}/.opencode-host-sync/auth.json ${HOME}/.local/share/opencode/auth.json && chmod 600 ${HOME}/.local/share/opencode/auth.json; fi
